agent_explanation: Fast shallow-angle graze on a 0.2-thick horizontal plate defeats the impulse/positional correction: the body contacts the top face at step 39 with unchanged vx~46.6, then sinks deeper each step (gap +0.007 -> -0.072 -> -0.152) while vx stays exactly constant and vy keeps falling under gravity, i.e. no bounce impulse or depenetration is applied. With 7 substeps per step the per-substep motion (~0.026) is far below wall thickness, so it is not tunneling through but a failed resting/grazing contact on a thin box. Thickening the wall while keeping the same top face restores the bounce.
